geometry: A white, square-cornered L shape marks the top and left edges of the rear sheet, and a white rectangle represents the front sheet. On the 20 x 20 canvas, the rear shape spans x=1..15 and y=1..15 with 2-unit strokes; the front rectangle spans x=5..19 and y=5..19. The background is transparent.
limitations: None apparent in the inspected 8x rendering.
